authority_proof.authority_sufficiency: The trusted administrative actor may allocate nonsecret planned identities and validate immutable source scope. Issuing credential/grant, signing, authentication/admission and execution remain independently guarded capabilities. UUID creation cannot make any of those true.
authority_proof.trust_limit: Trusted ADMIN is architectural authority, not an added SQL role or proof against malicious host superuser. No new separation-of-duties claim.

BINDING_PLAN_IMMUTABILITY: All immutable fields fixed after attribution/materialization; committed header plain INSERT; permanent tombstones deny rebind; changed source/IDs/time is not an in-place revision

BINDING_PLAN_REPLAY_SEMANTICS.logical_preparation_identity: Existing final ceremony accepted allocation context identified by (incarnation,plan_id,run_id,binding_id) and exact allocated ID set/immutable approved scope. No extra ceremony-attempt UUID/table.
BINDING_PLAN_REPLAY_SEMANTICS.server_attempt_separate: offline_attempt.attempt_id plus generation and execution/instance ownership are later server/launcher identities; never equated to plan_id or run_id. Same binding may support governed later generations without a new plan identity.
BINDING_PLAN_REPLAY_SEMANTICS.classification: Same frozen allocation/context and exact semantic request is a logical retry. Changed immutable context, a proven closed/abandoned root followed by newly authorized preparation, or a different plan_id is a new logical allocation/ceremony. An operational generation change alone is not a new binding or plan. Unknown lineage denies both mutation and regeneration.
BINDING_PLAN_REPLAY_SEMANTICS.no_idempotency_table: Existing immutable registration uniqueness/tombstones and command operation receipts suffice. Pre-effect context uses existing plan/input recovery representation; its crash persistence mechanics remain separate, no new storage system here.
BINDING_PLAN_REPLAY_SEMANTICS.fingerprint_role: Derived commitment to complete semantic38-field plan; not independent authority or replacement for primary/unique keys. Equality alone never makes a replay executable.

PLAN_FINGERPRINT.codec: u32be(domain UTF8 length)||domain||u16be(38)||ascending field u16be(tag)||u32be(payload length)||payload; present01||canonical bytes, null00 (all header inputs required nonnull)
PLAN_FINGERPRINT.types: UUID16 network order; positive u32 versions; instant i64 epoch microseconds; strict NFC UTF8 text; hashes32; four purpose-sorted OID/name slot records. No normalization/defaults.
excluded: retained canonical bytes as additional tag (already committed by manifest digest/hash)
PLAN_FINGERPRINT.generation_event: Once complete authorized allocation + actual manifest bytes + header times and exact policy/slots exist, compute during final ceremony before complete header registration. May compute before signature because signature is not an input; no hash is physically required now.
PLAN_FINGERPRINT.same_plan_definition: Same exact canonical38-field semantic scope, including run/plan/binding/operation IDs, retained-manifest hashes, times, policy and sorted slots. Semantically identical slot order permutations encode identically by existing sort rule. Different IDs/time are a changed plan, not an equivalent logical retry.
PLAN_FINGERPRINT.mutation_property: All38 fields enter injective tagged canonical framing; authority-relevant mutation changes bytes or invalidates the contract. SHA256 commitment assumes collision resistance; finite checks do not prove mathematical absence of all collisions.
PLAN_FINGERPRINT.proof_scope: YES_DESIGN. Source contract plus independent retained-vector decode/reencode, same-input checks and every-tag mutations. No new actual binding fingerprint or DB/JVM parity claim.
